extensions.name: regexp_match
extensions.body: SELECT pg_catalog.regexp_match( $1::pg_catalog.text, $2::pg_catalog.text, CASE WHEN pg_catalog.strpos($3, 'c') = 0 THEN  $3 || 'i' ELSE $3 END );

extensions.name: regexp_matches
extensions.body: SELECT pg_catalog.regexp_matches( $1::pg_catalog.text, $2::pg_catalog.text, CASE WHEN pg_catalog.strpos($3, 'c') = 0 THEN  $3 || 'i' ELSE $3 END );

extensions.name: regexp_replace
extensions.body: SELECT pg_catalog.regexp_replace( $1::pg_catalog.text, $2::pg_catalog.text, $3, CASE WHEN pg_catalog.strpos($4, 'c') = 0 THEN  $4 || 'i' ELSE $4 END);

extensions.name: regexp_split_to_array
extensions.body: SELECT pg_catalog.regexp_split_to_array( $1::pg_catalog.text, $2::pg_catalog.text, CASE WHEN pg_catalog.strpos($3, 'c') = 0 THEN  $3 || 'i' ELSE $3 END );

extensions.name: regexp_split_to_table
extensions.body: SELECT pg_catalog.regexp_split_to_table( $1::pg_catalog.text, $2::pg_catalog.text, CASE WHEN pg_catalog.strpos($3, 'c') = 0 THEN  $3 || 'i' ELSE $3 END );

extensions.name: bookings_no_overlap
extensions.definition: CREATE INDEX bookings_no_overlap ON fx.bookings USING gist (during)

extensions.name: bookings_code_key
extensions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_code_key ON fx.bookings USING btree (code) NULLS NOT DISTINCT

extensions.name: bookings_pkey
extensions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_pkey ON fx.bookings USING btree (id)

extensions.name: bookings_lower_idx
extensions.definition: CREATE INDEX bookings_lower_idx ON fx.bookings USING btree (lower(during), room_id DESC) INCLUDE (label) WITH (fillfactor='70')

extensions.name: bookings_audit
extensions.definition: CREATE TRIGGER bookings_audit AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR TRUNCATE ON fx.bookings FOR EACH STATEMENT EXECUTE FUNCTION fx.touch()

extensions.name: bookings_touch
extensions.definition: CREATE TRIGGER bookings_touch BEFORE UPDATE ON fx.bookings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fx.touch()

extensions.name: events_pkey
extensions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_pkey ON ONLY fx.events USING btree (id, happened)

extensions.name: events_2026_pkey
extensions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX events_2026_pkey ON fx.events_2026 USING btree (id, happened)

extensions.name: room_counts_id
extensions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX room_counts_id ON fx.room_counts USING btree (id)

SELECT r.id,
    count(b.id) AS bookings
   FROM (fx.rooms r
     LEFT JOIN fx.bookings b ON ((b.room_id = r.id)))
  GROUP BY r.id;

extensions.name: room_names_insert
extensions.definition: CREATE TRIGGER room_names_insert INSTEAD OF INSERT ON fx.room_names FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fx.room_names_insert()

extensions.name: rooms_pkey
extensions.definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX rooms_pkey ON fx.rooms USING btree (id)

origin.location: COMMENT ON CONSTRAINT code_length ON DOMAIN fx.code

extensions.name: room_ids
extensions.body:
BEGIN ATOMIC
 SELECT rooms.id
    FROM fx.rooms;
END

extensions.name: room_list
extensions.body: SELECT id, name FROM fx.rooms WHERE id >= min_id

extensions.name: total
extensions.identityArguments: a integer, OUT total bigint, VARIADIC rest integer[]

extensions.name: bookings_expr
extensions.definition: CREATE STATISTICS fx.bookings_expr ON lower(during) FROM fx.bookings

extensions.name: bookings_stats
extensions.definition: CREATE STATISTICS fx.bookings_stats (ndistinct, dependencies) ON room_id, code FROM fx.bookings
